summary: Include Cargo build scripts in source fingerprints

delivery.outcome: Include the selected Cargo package build script exactly once in source_sha256 and reject invalid script paths before compilation. Validate real source-distribution wheel builds and native results; publish through independent review and merge, release and preserve owned checkout.
nonGoals: Change runtime APIs, ABI, kernel/header, dependencies, platforms or registry/deployment.
General Cargo workspace/dependency graph support, build-script dynamic I/O/environment provenance or sandboxing.
Protected policy changes or complete Docs adoption.

architecture.decision: Private Cargo package.build resolver: absent means auto-discover default build.rs, true requires default script, false disables, nonempty relative string chooses a script. Require a regular nonsymlink file confined to project; permit parent-relative paths inside project. Validate during configuration and append to digest only if not already hashed. Keep existing digest unchanged without selected additional input.
architecture.rollback: Protected reviewed revert; preserve previous artifacts and ignored worktree data.

validation.evidence: Default/custom/shared build-script-only changes alter source digest and actual native results through sdist->wheel; disabled/absent scripts preserve fingerprint; missing, malformed, escaping and linked script inputs rejected before compilation.
Full suites, final wheel/sdist, installed APIs and native export hashes pass; canonical standard v16 binds exact source and safe receipts, own document passes pinned Docs check.
Local and required remote gates; independent Validator exact-head approval and merge; verified local fast-forward, released lease and preserved exact-path worktree cleanup/audit.
